def factor_volume_confirmed_return_ewm_diff(df):
    """Average return on volume-expansion days minus average return on volume-contraction days, using exponentially weighted means to emphasize recent observations."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    vol_change = df_copy['volume'].pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    up_mask = vol_change > 0
    down_mask = vol_change < 0
    up_num = ret.where(up_mask, 0.0).ewm(halflife=10, min_periods=5).mean()
    up_den = up_mask.astype(float).ewm(halflife=10, min_periods=5).mean()
    down_num = ret.where(down_mask, 0.0).ewm(halflife=10, min_periods=5).mean()
    down_den = down_mask.astype(float).ewm(halflife=10, min_periods=5).mean()
    up_mean = up_num / up_den.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    down_mean = down_num / down_den.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = up_mean - down_mean
    df_copy['factor_volume_confirmed_return_ewm_diff'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_volume_confirmed_return_ewm_diff']
description: Preserves the parent's economic mechanism of directional price-volume coherence: average return on days when volume expands minus average return on days when volume contracts. The mutation replaces the trailing 20-day simple moving averages with exponentially weighted moving averages (halflife=10). This gives more weight to recent volume-confirmed price moves, reducing lag and potentially improving IC/ICIR while retaining the core rank-order stability captured by the parent. No additional features are added; the mechanism remains a single conditional mean difference.
